# cpanel_ssl_certificate (Data Source)

Looks up one stored cPanel SSL certificate. The data source reads only the public certificate and metadata; it never reads private keys.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "cpanel_ssl_certificate" "example" {
  id = "certificate-id-from-cpanel"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) The certificate identifier assigned by cPanel.

### Read-Only

- `certificate` (String) The PEM-encoded public X.509 certificate.
- `created` (Number) The certificate creation time reported by cPanel as a Unix timestamp.
- `domain_is_configured` (Boolean) Whether cPanel reports a configured domain for the certificate.
- `domains` (Set of String) The certificate domains reported by cPanel.
- `fingerprint_sha256` (String) The lowercase SHA-256 fingerprint of the certificate DER bytes.
- `friendly_name` (String) The display name stored by cPanel for the certificate.
- `installed` (Boolean) Whether cPanel reports the certificate on an installed SSL virtual host.
- `is_self_signed` (Boolean) Whether cPanel reports the certificate as self-signed.
- `issuer_common_name` (String) The certificate issuer common name.
- `key_algorithm` (String) The certificate public-key algorithm reported by cPanel.
- `modulus_length` (Number) The public-key modulus length reported by cPanel, when applicable.
- `not_after` (Number) The certificate validity end as a Unix timestamp.
- `not_before` (Number) The certificate validity start as a Unix timestamp.
- `serial` (String) The certificate serial reported by cPanel.
- `signature_algorithm` (String) The certificate signature algorithm reported by cPanel.
- `subject_common_name` (String) The certificate subject common name.
- `validation_type` (String) The validation type reported by cPanel, when present.
